FN-1F59Z3-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 144
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/03/2024
House Bill 144as introduced would appropriate a total of $651,202,906 from the Education
Trust Fund for fiscal year ending 2024 to various state departments, agencies, and higher
education institutions.
Additionally, this bill would amend the Education Trust Fund Apprpriations Act for Fiscal Year
2024 (Act 2023-379) to clarify school nurse experience requirements.
Page 1

FN-1F59Z3-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 144
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/09/2024
House Bill 144as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would appropriate a
total of $651,202,906 from the Education Trust Fund for fiscal year 2024 to various state
departments, agencies, and higher education institutions.
Additionally, this bill would: (1) appropriate $29,998,245 to the K-12 Capital Grant Program,
conditioned upon the passage of HB 415, which would repeal the Distressed Institutions of
Higher Education Revolving Loan Program; and (2) amend the Education Trust Fund
Appropriations Act for Fiscal Year 2024 (Act 2023-379) to clarify school nurse experience
requirements.
Page 1

FN-1F59Z3-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 144
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/26/2024
House Bill 144as passed the House of Representatives would appropriate a total of
$651,202,906 from the Education Trust Fund for fiscal year 2024 to various state departments,
agencies, and institutions of higher education.
Additionally, this bill would, conditioned upon the passage of HB 415, which would repeal the
Distressed Institutions of Higher Education Revolving Loan Program, appropriate $15,000,000
to the K-12 Capital Grant Program and $14,998,245 to the Executive Commission on
Community Services Grants.
